objects.title: Research Project
objects.description: Supervised student activities on research projects identified on an individual or small-group basis.

objects.title: Railroad Industry Overview and Economic Regulation
objects.description: This course explores the relationship between railroads and customers, competitors, and the political, regulatory, and economic environment.

objects.title: Railroad Track Location, Construction and Maintenance
objects.description: Principles of railroad track location, alignment, elements and safety regulations.

objects.title: Railroad Operation and Safety
objects.description: Basics of rail operations, including the role of terminals and safety principles.

objects.title: Railroad Communications and Signals
objects.description: Principles of the separation of trains, including signals, interlocking, and communications.

objects.title: Railroad Operations Practicum
objects.description: Practicum (lectures, supervised field work, laboratories) exploring practical problems in rail operations and safety.

objects.title: Railroad Track Practicum
objects.description: Practicum (lectures, labs, supervised field experiences) exploring the construction and repair of track.

objects.title: Railroad Mechanical Practicum
objects.description: Practicum (lectures, labs, supervised field experiences) examining the repair of locomotives and cars.

objects.title: Railroad Capstone Project
objects.description: Capstone project to integrate course knowledge in a team-based project.

objects.title: Internship
objects.description: Supervised off-campus, nongroup instruction including field experiences, practica, or internships. Written and oral critique of activity required.

objects.title: Independent Studies
objects.description: Creative projects, including research and design, that are supervised on an individual basis and that fall outside the scope of formal courses.

objects.title: Special Topics
objects.description: Formal courses given infrequently to explore, in depth, a comparatively narrow subject that may be topical or of special interest.
